gre_general.value: The Fulton Schools of Engineering say the GRE is required for PhD programs (the program page itself does not list it); at-home GRE not accepted.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 (before January 21, 2026) or 5 on the new scale, above ASU's 80 minimum.
toefl_min.quote: An applicant whose native language is not English is required to achieve a minimum score of 5, or 100 (taken at at testing center) if taken before January 21, 2026, on the TOEFL iBT® exam regardless of their current residency.

supervisor.value: The program page does not say whether an advisor is needed before admission.

funding.value: Funding is not described on the program page.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's or master's in any field qualifies.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are eligible to apply to the program if they have earned a bachelor's or master's degree in any field from a regionally accredited institution.
